task.title: Filter corpus samples by lesson presence
task.objective: Select records by structural lesson-list presence without inspecting, normalizing, or inferring lesson content
acceptance_criteria: True matches a non-empty lessons list
False matches an empty lessons list
Lesson text does not affect the structural predicate
The option composes with every existing sample filter

attempts.summary: Added focused tests for present and absent lessons, composition, limits, invalid input, and malformed records
attempts.diagnostic: The CLI rejected the unknown has-lessons option

attempts.summary: Added strict boolean parsing and exact lesson-list emptiness matching

outcome.summary: Deterministic sampling supports inference-free selection by lesson-list presence

lessons: Presence filters should preserve authored text exactly and inspect only schema structure
The same full-corpus failure boundary applies even when a record would not match
